output.reason: The kind "none" is right, but the proposed statement is wrong. The linked PR describes itself as a "Specification for fluxcd/notification-controller#1097" [ev-b280728aa2ed], and its only changed file is the newly added rfcs/0011-opentelemetry-tracing/README.md [ev-470c6560a1d8]. So the changelog line [ev-0ac14f075687] records an RFC design document, not a tracing capability shipped in this release. The statement and remediation should not say tracing can be opted into in 2.7.0.

correction.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, PR #5321 only adds the RFC-0011 OpenTelemetry Tracing specification document to the flux2 repository. It ships no code, setting or behaviour change, so there is no operational consequence (informational).

consequence.statement: PR #5321 adds only the RFC-0011 specification document (rfcs/0011-opentelemetry-tracing/README.md), described as a specification for notification-controller#1097. No runtime behaviour, setting or resource changes in this release, so an environment that does nothing is unaffected.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; the RFC is a design document only.
